findings.finding: The game client targets x64 Windows 10 and Windows 11.
The project uses Rust and its implementation repository is private during development.
Users must supply a Steam MCC installation with Halo 3, including its campaign.
A Reclaimer release supports a particular game-engine version; an engine update may require a new client release.
Players and servers must use matching Reclaimer versions to play together.

limitations: Maintainer-authored requirements, not an independent executable or multiplayer test. Page line numbers are retrieval-specific. No Reclaimer executable was downloaded or run.
